# Quality smoke fixtures

`smoke.jsonl` contains short synthetic examples authored for Wenyi's offline
quality tests. They are not extracts from user books, training data, or an
independent translation-quality benchmark. Their purpose is to exercise input,
candidate, blind-export and report contracts without paid services.

Run from the repository root:

```bash
uv run --no-sync python scripts/evaluate_translation_quality.py \
  --mock --input packages/core/tests/fixtures/quality/smoke.jsonl \
  --output /tmp/wenyi-quality-smoke
```

`labels` are evaluation metadata and must stay outside model prompts. Use
`book_id` to keep development and evaluation splits separate when supplying a
larger authorized dataset. A `budget_control` translation, when present, is
caller-supplied and is not generated by the tool. Mock scores cannot establish
that any wording, threshold, language direction or literary style is better.

See [the quality guide](../../../../../docs/quality.md) for JSONL fields,
explicit paid opt-in, independent human evaluation and budget limitations.
